children: NORTH BILLERICA, MA / ACCESS Newswire / November 11, 2026 /

, a leading manufacturer of clean energy products, reported revenues of $7.87 million and net loss of $1.59 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to revenues of $7.18 million, and a net loss of $2.13 million in 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, revenues were $19.96 million, and the net loss was $5.86 million, compared to revenues of $21.76 million, and a net loss of $4.25 million in 2025. Our cash and cash equivalents balance was $5.33 million at September 30, 2026.

Abinand Rangesh, CEO of Tecogen, commented, "Revenue increased substantially in the third quarter compared to the first two quarters this year as well as Q3 2025. The higher revenue and customer deposits means that our current cash position has increased to $5.7m today with a further $800k expected to be collected in the next two weeks. Compared to the same period last year, gross profit margin also increased by 7 percentage points showing that operational improvements are starting to take effect.

In addition, the backlog is presently more than $8m. The increases in utility rates and power shortages is accelerating demand for our products, especially in large commercial, healthcare and industrial facilities. Over 70% of this backlog constitutes large property portfolio owners and energy services companies. Therefore, successful initial projects may open the door to significant additional business.

During the call, I will shed more light on the status of the data center pipeline and the pathway to closing them. I will also update shareholders on an exciting innovation we have developed that allows customers to use our dual power source technology as a retrofit to existing chillers, dry coolers, and other loads in data centers or other types of facilities. This innovation allows us to scale up production quickly while increasing margins. It is also timely given potential new data center construction moratoriums as it allows a data center to maximize power on already approved sites."
Net Loss and Earnings Per Share

The net loss for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $1.59 million compared to a net loss of $2.13 million for the same period of 2025, a decrease in the net loss of $0.54 million, due to increased Services segment revenue and gross profit, offset partially by an increase in operating expenses. EPS for the quarters ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 was a loss of $0.05/share and $0.07, respectively.

The net loss for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $5.86 million compared to a net loss of $4.25 million for the same period of 2025, an increase in the net loss of $1.61 million, due to decreased revenue and gross profit from our Products segment and an increase in operating expenses. EPS for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 was a loss of $0.20/share and $0.16/share, respectively.

Loss from operations for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $1.57 million compared to a loss from operations of $2.10 million for the same period in 2025, a decrease of $0.53 million, due to increased revenue and gross profit from our Services segment, offset partially an increase in operating expenses.

Loss from operations for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $5.85 million compared to a loss from operations of $4.11 million for the same period in 2025, an increase of $1.74 million, due to decreased revenue and gross profit from our Products segment and an increase in operating expenses.
Revenues for the three months ended September 30, 2026 were $7.87 million compared to $7.18 million for the same period in 2025, a 9.6% increase.

Products revenues in the three months ended September 30, 2026 were $3.05 million compared to $2.98 million for the same period in 2025, an increase of 2.2%. The increase in revenue during the quarter ended September 30, 2026 is due to increased chiller revenue, offset partially by decreased cogeneration and engineered accessories revenue.

Services revenues in the three months ended September 30, 2026 were $4.46 million, compared to $3.94 million for the same period in 2025, an increase of 13.2% due to increased revenues from the acquired Aegis maintenance contracts and increased revenues from existing service contracts.

Energy Production revenues in the three months ended September 30, 2026 were $0.36 million compared to $0.26 million for the same period in 2025, an increase of 42.0%. The increase in Energy Production revenue is due to improved site operations in the three months ended September 30, 2026.
Revenues for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $19.96 million compared to $21.76 million for the same period in 2025, an 8.3% decrease.

Products revenues in the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $5.36 million compared to $8.67 million for the same period in 2025, a decrease of 38.2%. The decrease in revenue during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 is due to decreases in chiller, cogeneration and engineered accessories revenue.

Services revenues in the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $13.47 million, compared to $12.15 million for the same period in 2025, an increase of 10.9% due to increased revenues from existing contracts and increased revenues from the acquired Aegis maintenance contracts.

Energy Production revenues in the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $1.12 million compared to $0.93 million for the same period in 2025, an increase of 20.9%. The increase in Energy Production revenue is due to improved site operations in the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

Gross profit for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased to $2.95 million compared to $2.18 million in the same period in 2025 due to increased Services revenues and lower costs. Gross margin increased to 37.4% in the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to 30.4% for the same period in 2025. The increase is due to higher Services segment margin in the three months ended September 30, 2026.

Gross profit for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 decreased to $7.71 million compared to $7.87 million in the same period in 2025 due to lower Products revenue. Gross margin increased to 38.6% in the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to 36.2% for the same period in 2025. The increase in gross margin was due to higher Services segment margin in the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

Operating expenses increased $0.23 million, or 5.3%, to $4.51 million in the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $4.28 million in the same period in 2025, due to increases in payroll, benefits, stock-based compensation, credit losses, and depreciation and amortization.

Operating expenses increased $1.59 million, or 13.3%, to $13.56 million in the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $11.97 million in the same period in 2025, due to increases in payroll, benefits, stock-based compensation, credit losses, and depreciation and amortization.

Adjusted EBITDA was negative $1.01 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to negative $1.67 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, adjusted EBITDA was negative $4.37 million compared to negative $3.22 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. (Adjusted EBITDA is defined as net income or loss attributable to Tecogen, adjusted for interest, income taxes, depreciation and amortization, stock-based compensation expense, unrealized gain or loss on investment securities, goodwill impairment charges and other non-cash non-recurring charges or gains including abandonment of intangible assets and asset impairment. See the table following the Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations for a reconciliation from net income (loss) to Adjusted EBITDA, as well as important disclosures about the Company's use of Adjusted EBITDA).

Tecogen Inc. designs, manufactures, sells, installs, and maintains high efficiency, ultra-clean, cogeneration products including engine-driven combined heat and power, air conditioning systems, and high-efficiency water heaters for residential, commercial, recreational and industrial use. The company provides cost effective, environmentally friendly and reliable products for energy production that nearly eliminate criteria pollutants and significantly reduce a customer's carbon footprint. In business for over 35 years, Tecogen has shipped more than 3,200 units, supported by an established network of engineering, sales, and service personnel in key markets in North America. For more information, please visit www.tecogen.com or contact us for a free Site Assessment.
